metadata.remarks: Data Classification defines the capability to assign sensitivity levels and associated obligations to institutional data. Classification informs handling, encryption, disclosure, and retention requirements but does not itself enforce those controls. All downstream data protection patterns assume data-classification has been established.

components.title: Classification Scheme

components.title: Impact and Risk Mapping

implemented-requirements.remarks: Assess and document risk impact associated with data sensitivity.

components.title: Regulatory and Contractual Obligations
components.description: Identification of legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements associated with data classes.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Identify requirements and constraints applicable to sensitive data.

components.title: Classification Assertion and Labeling

implemented-requirements.remarks: Label data to reflect sensitivity and associated handling requirements.
